camel_example: aliyun dts DescribePreCheckStatus --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId i03e3zty16i0000 --PageSize 30 --StructType before --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekz4us4iruleja' --StructPhase View --JobCode 01 --ZeroEtlJob false --PageNo 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name dewuprop
description_en: Queries the execution details of subtasks of a DTS task, including precheck, schema migration or synchronization, full data migration or synchronization, and incremental data migration or synchronization
description_zh: 调用DescribePreCheckStatus查询DTS任务的子任务执行详情，包括预检查、库表结构迁移或初始化、全量迁移或初始化、增量迁移或同步
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-pre-check-status --dts-job-id i03e3zty16i0000 --page-no 1 --page-size 30 --job-code 01 --struct-type before --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --struct-phase View --name dewuprop --zero-etl-job false --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePreCheckStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The task code. Specify this parameter to query a specific subtask type of the DTS task. Valid values:

01: precheck.
02: schema migration or initial schema synchronization.
03: full data migration or initial full data synchronization.
04: incremental data migration or incremental data synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
任务码，传入本参数指定所需查询的DTS任务的子任务类型，取值为：

01：预检查。
02：库表结构迁移或初始化。
03：全量迁移或初始化。
04：增量迁移或同步
parameters.name: job_code

parameters.help_en:
The type of schema definition. Valid values:

before: schema migration or initial schema synchronization.
after: DDL operations during incremental data migration or incremental data synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
结构定义的类型，取值：

before：库表结构迁移或初始化。
after：增量数据迁移或同步的DDL操作
parameters.name: struct_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The filter. Filters tables, views, and functions in schema migration
parameters.help_zh: 过滤项，结构迁移中的表、视图、函数
parameters.name: struct_phase

parameters.help_en: The filter. Performs a fuzzy match on table names
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:

false: No.
true: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：

false：否。
true：是
parameters.name: zero_etl_job
